component: EC076 Regenerative Heat Exchanger (Rotary Wheel / Recuperator)
description: Effectiveness-NTU for regenerative HX with carryover/leakage penalty, fouling resistance, and temperature-dependent property corrections for gas streams. Accounts for the cyclic nature of regenerators via the heat capacity ratio C_r* correction.

unit.name: Generic Air-to-Air Rotary Regenerator (HVAC/turbomachinery class)
unit.source: Incropera & DeWitt (2006) ch.11; Shah & Sekulic (2003) ch.5; Kays & London (1984); ASHRAE HB 2020

U_clean.note: Clean matrix overall HTC for air-air (gas-gas); typical 60-120 W/m2K

A.note: Total heat transfer area of matrix

Cr_star.note: Dimensionless heat capacity rate of matrix Cr* = C_r/(C_min); >5 is near ideal

carryover_leakage.note: Fractional leakage/carryover loss (typically 1-5% for rotary wheels)

T_h_in.note: Regenerators often used in high-temperature applications
